chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Durust, from Ibn Muskan, who said: 'Umar ibn Yazid narrated to me from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.'
That he asked him about a man who forgot to perform the two rak'ahs, the obligatory two rak'ahs, at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام until he reached Mina. He said: 'He should perform them in Mina.'

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rak'ahs; the prayer connected to tawaf
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory rite; indicating the required nature of the act
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject in the ruling
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the Station of Ibrahim عليه السلام; the usual place for the two rak'ahs after tawaf
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina; the location where the missed prayer may be performed

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he forgets the two rak'ahs of tawaf until reaching Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the two rak'ahs of tawaf until after leaving the area of Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام and reaching Mina. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that he should perform those two rak'ahs in Mina, indicating that the prayer remains due even if its usual place was missed.
